name: Los Cucos Mexican Food
notes: All 4 photos are printed wall menu boards; photos 1 and 3 show the same Breakfast/Burritos board at different times (merged), photo 2 shows Tacos/SD Bowl/Tostadas/Tortas/Side Orders, photo 4 shows Unique Burros/Fries/Fajitas/Chips plus a handwritten specials sticky note. Storefront branding visible in photo 4 reads 'Los 3 Compadres Mexican Food', not the given restaurant name, but content was transcribed as instructed. A few line items were fully hidden behind green tape/paper covering the name and were dropped rather than guessed. Carne Asada, Pastor, and Pollo Asado burrito prices conflicted between the two shots of the same board ($10.50 vs $11.50); price omitted for those three rather than guessed.
